description: Create, convert, validate, and publish Claude Code plugins.

evals.name: Activation routing among plugin-development / plugin-rulebook / plugin-validator
evals.prompt: Reasoning-only: read plugin-development/SKILL.md, plugin-rulebook/SKILL.md, and plugin-validator.md's frontmatter descriptions. For each of 3 requests (scaffold a new plugin; check R1-R32 naming/tool-scoping; validate manifest/directory wiring), say which component's description signals it should handle that request, quoting the exact phrase.
evals.expected_output: 1: plugin-development (decided name/purpose scaffolding phrase). 2: plugin-rulebook (naming conventions and R1-R32 formatting compliance phrase). 3: plugin-validator (validates overall plugin structure, manifest, and component wiring phrase).
